jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Analytics
jobs.description:
Job Description

Who We Are

Horizon Media
, founded in 1989 by Bill Koenigsberg, is recognized as one of the most innovative marketing and advertising firms. We are headquartered in New York City, with offices in Los Angeles and Toronto. A leader in driving business solutions for marketers, Horizon is known for its highly personal approach to client service. Renowned for its incredible culture, Horizon is consistently named to all the prestigious annual Best Places to Work lists published by Fortune, AdAge, Crain’s New York Business and Los Angeles Business Journal. Together we are building a place of belonging.

At Horizon, we understand the value that different perspectives can bring to our clients and culture, so we strive for an environment where our employees feel welcomed, safe and empowered. We value YOU and believe that your authentic voice and unique perspective allows us to create a more rewarding culture, and experience, together.

Our simple recipe for success? We hire talented people (thinkers, doers, dreamers, makers), challenge them and give them every opportunity to grow.

Job Summary

Horizon Media runs the premier marketing analytics practice in the United States combining great technology, methods and talent to grow our clients’ business. We are experts in marketing measurement; advising some of the biggest brands in the country on how to structure optimal marketing programs, how to refine their approach over time and have a great time doing it.

At Horizon we pride ourselves on working collaboratively, building strong relationships and growing together. The agency creates an environment that rewards curiosity, risk taking and brings out the best in people. We invest in our talent and make sure to continuously keep up with the rapidly evolving data science and marketing landscapes.

Horizon is currently looking for a Senior
Analyst, Analytics
to do great work with us. The ideal candidate is passionate about the data science space, continuously seeks to learn more and loves applying analytics skills within a marketing context.

If these questions sound interesting, we want to hear from you:

How much will my brand’s sales increase if I invest $1MM more in TV ads this year?
Did the funny online ad create a more favorable view of my brand with consumers?
Why did 90% of users uninstall my brand’s app after one day?

What You’ll Do

40% Data Communication/Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely across the media planning and brand strategy teams to develop KPIs and reporting methodologies / approaches that match back to campaign and brand goals and to communicate that based on client needs.
Communicate concise data points, trends, and measurement strategies to a broad audience - from development and technical experts to traditional brand managers.
Drive innovation by developing new analytical approaches, optimizing data workflows, and designing scalable data structures to improve process efficiency and insight generation.

20% KPI/Reporting & Dashboard/Visualization Development

Build robust data visualizations and interactive dashboards that are capable of delivering information in an intelligent and digestible manner.

20% Analysis & Insight Generation

Query database tables into formats that are easily analyzable and suitable for visualization.
Analyze information to bring forward insights, results, and suggesting optimizations to improve said results. 
Must be able to peel through the layers of reported data, disregarding the unnecessary, and deliver analysis and insight in a constructive and concise manner both internal and external client constituents.

20% Client Management

Must be able to manage client expectations successfully and present key findings throughout the engagement.

Who You Are

An analytical mindset with the ability to communicate findings to others
An independent worker with strong time management and organization skills
A problem solver with the ability to develop creative solutions
A strong team player, willing to roll up your sleeves and collaborate with others
Nimble and flexible with ability to succeed in a fast-paced environment
Detail oriented with a commitment to follow through

Preferred Skills & Experience

Strong analytical skills are required, including the ability to analyze raw data, draw conclusions, and summarize actionable recommendations and their forecasted outcomes/implications.
Proficiency in ad-serving, ad verification and site analytics platforms such as DCM, Innovid, Extreme Reach, IAS, Double Verify, Adobe Analytics and Google Analytics
Familiarity with concepts of database design and SQL
Exposure to mobile, social, tablet measurement platforms and methodology
Proven skills in analytical and strategic thinking, project management, presenting, and communication
Understanding of role of multi-touch attribution and other advanced analytics in media evaluation
Experience with syndicated research sources/tools (Gfk, MRI, Simmons, Scarborough, IMS, Nielsen, comScore)
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Powerpoint
Thought leadership on all aspects of digital advertising, digital media strategy and standard media measurement
Strong understanding of traditional and digital advertising, strategy and measurement
Experience managing and coordinating efforts across various teams/offices
Ability to manage and prioritize a number of concurrent tasks
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to convey and package complex technical ideas to multiple audiences
2-3 years relevant experience

#HM

Horizon Media is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Salary Range

$85,000.00 - $100,000.00

A successful applicant’s actual base salary may vary based on factors such as individual’s skill sets, experience, training, education, licensure/certifications, and qualifications for the role. As an organization, we take an aptitude and competency-based hiring approach. We provide a competitive total rewards package including a discretionary bonus and a variety of benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, company paid holidays and unlimited paid time off (PTO), mental health and wellness resources, pet insurance, childcare resources, identity theft insurance, fertility assistance programs, and fitness reimbursement.

We are seeking a Technical Business Analyst who has experience in Fixed Income Trading System.

jobs.title: Treasury Senior Analyst
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

Finance is one organization composed of ten functions forming the financial backbone of DTCC, leaders who stand at the forefront of DTCC’s competitive endeavors across the globe. From accountants and financial analysts to internal consultants and workplace designers, the CFO Organization employs diverse individuals who work together to help make DTCC a global leader in the financial services industry.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
Pension / Retirement benefits
Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

The Senior Treasury Analyst supports all aspects of our global cash management and margin administration operations. This includes managing short-term investments and cash balances, completing bank reconciliations, processing wires, and securities settlement activities. The Senior Analyst adheres to controls and risk mitigation strategies to invest large portfolios consisting of operating and client assets while maintaining access to default liquidity resources in the event of a member default.

This role will also support Treasury’s digital assets processing, including cryptocurrency management, funding operations and liquidity management. The Senior Analyst works closely with Risk Management and Settlement Operations, and interfaces with Operational Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Audit and Regulatory Relations to optimize operational controls, governance, and risk mitigation.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Ensures daily inflows and outflows of cash and securities are sufficient to satisfy clients’ Clearing Fund requirements
Diversify investments based on short-term cash position with list of approved financial institution counterparties
Processes bank transactions, including FX, debt servicing, and investments in accordance with policies and applicable regulatory requirements
Escalates liquidity issues and/or suspicious transactions to management
Supports execution of digital assets transactions, including on-chain transfers and exchange settlements
Monitors liquidity usage across wallets and blockchains, escalates shortfalls and rebalances in accordance with internal policies and procedures
Assists in daily and monthly reconciliations between custodians and blockchains
Interacts with internal stakeholder teams, and external financial counterparties
Performs daily reconciliation of bank accounts to ensure all transactions are valid and authorized
Prepare management analytics reports
Identifies risks and opportunities for process improvements to mitigate risk

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above.**

Qualifications

Minimum of 2 years of related experience in treasury or finance
Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or related fields (or equivalent degree/experience) required
Familiarity with treasury cash management systems

The salary range is indicative for roles at the same level within DTCC across all US locations. Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. jobs.description:
Job Purpose

In this high-visibility position, the Analyst will support NYSE's Global Listings, Capital Markets and Exchange Traded Funds (ETF) teams and NYSE management in obtaining new business and strengthening existing relationships. The Analyst will conduct data analysis, prepare presentation materials, oversee the new listing process for both operating companies and exchange traded products, manage databases, and work cross-functionally within the organization and with external stakeholders. The Analyst will liaise with C-level executives, investor relations professionals, ETF issuers and product teams, underwriters, outside counsel, members of the trading and market-making community, sales, events, marketing and regulation.

Responsibilities

Support the Capital Markets, Listings and ETF business lines.
Understand and communicate the NYSE and NYSE Arca value proposition to corporate and ETF issuers.
Customize presentations for IPO prospects, ETF issuers, client meetings and other transactions, including capital markets updates, industry comparisons, deal tables, peer trading comparisons and visibility proposals.
Lead companies and ETF issuers through the listing process, from pre-launch through listing day, serving as point of contact and coordinating with counsel, regulation and operations teams.
Execute Designated Market Maker (DMM) interviews with corporate issuers and support the selection process.
Maintain databases and report to management on market landscape, KPIs and the corporate and ETF pipelines.
Partner with senior team members on strategic projects across the NYSE, conducting research and analysis, preparing presentation materials, and supporting execution.

Knowledge And Experience

Degree in finance, economics, entrepreneurship, management or related field
1-3 years of experience in Capital Markets, asset management, ETFs or another directly applicable industry
Strong functional and interpersonal skills
Strategic and analytic thinker
Solution-oriented with a positive “can do” attitude
Proactive, self-motivated and able to take individual responsibility
Meticulous attention to detail
Juggles multiple priorities across business lines
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft products like Excel and PowerPoint
Familiarity with FactSet, Dealogic, PitchBook, and/or Salesforce

The expected base salary for this role, if located in New York, is between $85,000 - 105,000 USD.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst, Finance - SSL
jobs.description:
Job Responsibilities And Requirements

Standard Security Life (SSL) is a leading provider of New York Disability Benefit Law (DBL) and statutory paid family leave (PFL) insurance. SSL is a division of Reliance Matrix and a member of the Tokio Marine Group.

The Senior Business Analyst for SSL will work internally and with external vendors to monitor, review and reconcile transactions between the Company’s policy administrative system(s), the general ledger and the bank accounts while ensuring overall data integrity of the Company’s premium, claim and commission transactions. This role will also support the evaluation, execution and expansion of automation, analytics and artificial intelligence tools that improve company processes, strengthen controls and enhance decision support.

The Senior Business Analyst will be responsible for the completion of data related regulatory filings to the Company’s regulator(s).

The Senior Business Analyst will also be involved in the design and implementation of future applications, training, change requests and problem reports. They will collaborate with IT and management in other departments (Claims, Underwriting, Financial, etc.) to determine the appropriate functionality and integration of while ensuring current and future business requirements are met.

In addition, the Senior Business Analyst will help identify practical AI and automation use cases across SSL Finance and related functions, assist in defining requirements and success measures, coordinate with business and technology partners, and support adoption through testing, training, documentation and ongoing monitoring.

Duties And Responsibilities

Serves as the liaison to IT for all SSL Administrative system related issues.
Investigates user concerns identifies problems, makes recommendations for resolution and collaborates with IT to implement the fix/change.
Seeks user feedback related to system efficiency and functionality and requests system changes and enhancements, as appropriate.
Attends regular meetings with managers from Underwriting, Claims, IT, Financial, etc. to determine the priority of recommended changes/enhancements.
Chairs System meetings as necessary to provide feedback to the SSL Management Team regarding system performance, development and status.
Maintains users security and authority changes and additions as necessary.
Regularly meets with managers to discuss new procedures, system enhancements, etc.
Shares information or problems and provides a forum for team building.
Maintains consistent company process and regulatory compliance through appropriate staff communication and training.
Identifies opportunities to use automation, analytics and AI-enabled tools to reduce manual effort, improve reconciliation accuracy, strengthen exception reporting and increase timeliness of financial and operational insights.
Partners with Finance, IT, Claims, Underwriting and other stakeholders to document AI and automation business requirements, define expected outcomes, support prioritization and coordinate implementation activities.
Supports data readiness activities for AI-enabled solutions, including source-system analysis, data mapping, exception identification, validation routines and documentation of data limitations or control considerations.
Assists in testing, monitoring and validating AI or automation outputs to ensure results are accurate, explainable, appropriately controlled and aligned with business requirements before and after deployment.
Completes regulatory data filings with regulatory authorities as required.
Maintains documentation of AI-enabled workflows, automation rules, data transformations, process controls and user procedures to support auditability, regulatory compliance and operational continuity.
Develops and delivers user guidance, job aids and training materials to promote effective adoption of new systems, AI-enabled tools, dashboards and process changes.
Completes special projects as assigned by management.
Assumes additional responsibilities as needed.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities And/or Related Experience

Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as a business analyst.
Experience with process improvement, data analysis, reporting, workflow automation or AI-enabled business tools preferred.
Ability to handle multiple competing priorities and function with limited supervision.
Proven ability to work well in a high visibility, public oriented environment, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Proven ability to effectively participate in sales presentations and customer meetings.
Proven ability to work with the following equipment: personal computer programs (e-mail, Microsoft Word and Excel, etc.). Ability to use any or all of this equipment to track, measure and improve performance.
Working knowledge of data visualization, query, reporting or AI-assisted productivity tools, with the ability to evaluate outputs, identify exceptions and communicate findings to business stakeholders.
Proven ability to engage in presentations and deliver training.

Ability to Travel:
Up to 10%

The expected hiring range for this position is $100,310.00 - $133,890.00 annually for work performed in the primary location (New York, NY). This expected hiring range covers only base pay and excludes any other compensation components such as commissions or incentive awards. The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be based on several factors including work location, job-related skills, experience, qualifications, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Work location may be flexible if approved by the Company.

What We Offer

At Reliance Matrix, we believe that fostering an inclusive culture allows us to realize more of our potential. And we can’t do this without our most important asset—you.

That is why we offer a competitive pay package and a range of benefits to help team members thrive in their financial, physical, and mental wellbeing.

jobs.description:
Compensation Analyst, Americas
Industry: Luxury Retail

Salary:
$80,000–$95,000 base
Position Overview
We are partnering with a global luxury retail company seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Compensation Analyst
to support compensation planning and reporting across the United States, Canada, and Mexico.
Reporting to the Director of Compensation & Benefits, Americas, this position will focus heavily on staff cost budgeting, forecasting, payroll analysis, compensation reporting, and financial modeling.
The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Excel, comfortable working with complex data, and enjoys partnering across HR, Finance, and Retail leadership.

Compensation Planning & Financial Analysis

Manage annual staff cost budgets and forecasts across the Americas, including three annual forecast revisions.
Partner with Finance, Planning, and HR to track payroll, headcount, and compensation expenses.
Analyze monthly payroll actuals against forecasts, identify variances, and explain key drivers.
Prepare payroll bridges, compensation reports, and financial models.
Manage HR travel and expense budgets, including forecasting and monthly reporting.

Compensation Reporting & Analysis

Maintain accurate compensation data, master compensation files, and reporting dashboards.
Prepare monthly headcount reports and biannual turnover analyses.

Partner with Retail leadership on staffing and compensation planning for new store openings.
Support internal compensation changes, salary proposals, offer letters, and payroll updates.
Assist with biannual performance review and compensation cycles.
Collaborate with HR, Finance, and Payroll to ensure accurate compensation administration.
Review HR vendor invoices, track expenses, and support employment-related insurance cost reporting.

Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business, or a related field.

It’s why we work with some of the world’s leading creators to produce and share audio storytelling with our millions of global listeners. We are dreamers and inventors who come from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences to empower and inspire each other. Imagine your future with us.

About This Role

As a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer within the Customer Service Analytics team at Audible, you'll serve as a data-driven decision enabler for our Customer Service leadership team. You'll be responsible for designing, implementing, and

optimizing the reporting processes that deliver critical KPIs and business insights across our organization. Working with loosely defined problems, you'll transform complex data into clear, actionable narratives. Your role will be pivotal in

maintaining data governance standards while making insights readily accessible through efficient, self-service data solutions.

About You

You're a data storyteller who balances technical expertise with strong business acumen, particularly in the world of content. You excel at working cross-

functionally, translating business requirements into robust analytical frameworks. You're naturally curious, with an ability to look beyond immediate data requests to identify the underlying strategic questions that drive our Customer Service. You

thrive in ambiguous situations, delivering independently with minimal guidance while continuously improving data processes. Your communication skills are exceptional, allowing you to distill complex analyses into compelling insights for both technical and executive audiences. You establish strong relationships with your stakeholders that earn trust and influence decision-making.

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst - Orion Platform
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Treasury Analyst
New York, NY
Our Culture at Orion
At Orion, we are builders. We want to be the gold standard for people in the Commercial Services trades. We are building a 100+ year business with an A+ team, driven, excited about the future, and looking for people who want to build with us. We believe in hiring people with a growth mindset who are committed to building something bigger than themselves. Our culture is grounded in four core values: Coach, Compete, Collaborate, and Commit. We strive to be low ego, high performance, and deeply committed to our people, our Operating Companies, and our long-term vision.
Orion Services Group is a growing network of commercial services businesses across the United States, spanning HVAC, electrical, plumbing, building automation, and related trades. We are highly acquisitive, integrating 10-15 operating companies per year, and converting each acquisition into a stable, growth-ready business within the first 90 days of ownership.
Orion is a roll-up-your-sleeves culture. At all levels, we expect people to prioritize, act quickly and effectively, demonstrate agility in their thinking, and get the job done every day. This is not a sit-back-and-direct environment. We value doers, problem-solvers, and people who are hands-on and decisive.
The Role
The Treasury Analyst keeps cash moving across Orion's network of operating companies, from the weekly forecasting cycle through banking, payments, and lender reporting. This role sits on the Platform Treasury team and reports to the VP, Finance, Platform Treasury.
You will serve two groups of clients. Our operating companies rely on you to run a predictable forecasting cycle, get newly acquired companies up to speed, and help them improve how they manage working capital. Platform leadership relies on you for a clear group-level view of cash, a secure and well-administered banking platform, and accurate support for acquisition funding and lender reporting.
This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one. It blends recurring weekly and monthly cycles with project work, and a big part of the job is continuous improvement: finding ways to make each process faster, cleaner, and more automated over time. You will partner every week with OpCo finance leaders, Controllership, FP&A, Capital Markets, the deal team, and our banking partners.
What We Are Looking For
Core Competencies
Attention to detail - you check your own work before anyone else sees it, and you treat every wire, entitlement change, and forecast number as something that has to be right.
Follow-through - you keep the forecasting calendar on track and follow up with OpCo finance leaders until submissions are complete, without needing to be chased yourself.
Analytical curiosity - when a forecast misses or working capital moves, you dig in to understand why and help the OpCo fix the root cause, not just explain the variance.
Continuous improvement mindset - you look for ways to make each cycle faster, cleaner, and more automated, and you document the process so it runs the same way every time.
Sound judgment - you handle bank access, payments, and confidential financial information with care, and you know when to escalate.
Clear communication - you write and speak directly, and you can explain cash results to OpCo controllers and platform leaders alike.
Comfort with a fast pace - you balance recurring deadlines with project work and new acquisitions, and stay organized as priorities shift.
Low ego, high collaboration - you build strong working relationships across Treasury, Controllership, FP&A, the deal team, and the operating companies.
Experience and Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in treasury, corporate finance, FP&A, or public accounting, including relevant internships.
Solid Excel and data skills and a desire to grow them, including learning to build models others can follow, plus comfort using AI tools to automate and speed up routine work.
Exposure to J.P. Morgan Access or another commercial banking platform is a plus.
Familiarity with Workday Adaptive Planning or another planning tool, and a multi-entity ERP such as Sage Intacct, is a plus.
Background in a multi-entity, acquisitive, or private equity-backed company is a plus.
Interest in or exposure to leveraged finance, credit agreements, lender reporting, or foreign currency cash management is a plus.
CTP or CPA, or progress toward either, is a plus, not a requirement.
Key Responsibilities
Cash Forecasting and Reporting
Help run the weekly and monthly cash forecasting cycle with our operating companies, and help newly acquired companies get up to speed on reporting cadences and treasury platforms.
Help build the group-level cash forecast and weekly cash report in partnership with FP&A, and track forecast accuracy over time.
Monitor OpCo cash balances against targets and support the weekly cash sweep.
Banking and Payments
Support administration of our banking platform, including user access requests and bank account updates, in line with our policies.
Prepare wires for review and approval, and support acquisition funding and post-close payments, including tracking earnouts, deferred payments, and holdbacks.
Debt, Working Capital, and Governance
Help prepare quarterly lender reporting packages, track liquidity and leverage, and help forecast interest and other debt payments.
Partner with OpCos to investigate net working capital shortfalls, help roll out order-to-cash best practices, and support continuous improvement.
Help maintain legal entity and bank account records, entity compliance, and treasury procedures, and take on ad hoc analysis as priorities come up.
Reporting Structure
This position reports directly to the VP, Finance, Platform Treasury, and partners closely with OpCo finance leaders, Controllership, FP&A, Capital Markets, and the Execution team.

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) is seeking a high-caliber, early-career professional for the position of Executive Operations & AI Enablement Analyst, within Commercial & Corporate Functions & Services (CFS) Procurement. The role serves as a strategic enabler and force multiplier to the Vice President of Commercial & CFS Procurement, blending executive support, project coordination, leadership-team enablement, and hands-on digital and AI tooling into a single, integrated position. As the Executive Operations Analyst, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and direct exposure to executive decision-making. This is a talent-accelerator role offering direct exposure to executive leadership, enterprise-level strategy, supplier negotiations, and cross-functional execution, combined with a mandate to build with AI at the leading edge of how work gets done.

You will own the VP’s calendar end-to-end — issuing meeting invitations on the VP’s behalf, negotiating scheduling directly with internal senior leaders and external supplier executives, and orchestrating scheduling campaigns spanning the US, Europe, and Asia. You will produce daily and weekly executive intelligence products (day summaries and an interactive leadership dashboard) that keep the VP and Leadership Team focused on the highest-value priorities, and you will actively build and deploy AI and digital solutions — from automated reporting to working prototypes of business tools — that raise the productivity of the entire organization.

Executive Time & Operating Rhythm

Executive Reporting & Leadership Dashboards

Consolidate inputs from across Commercial & CFS Procurement into clear, executive-level status reporting.
Continuously improve reporting products based on leadership feedback, iterating week over week.

Project & Leadership Team Coordination

Coordinate and track strategic and operational initiatives across Commercial & CFS Procurement, maintaining action plans, milestones, and dependencies across the VP’s Leadership Team.
Support planning and orchestration of leadership meetings, working sessions (e.g., procurement/budget process-improvement sessions), category strategy reviews, and executive development programs.

jobs.title: Paralegal Analyst
jobs.description:
Balestriere Law Firm is seeking a paralegal-legal analyst for immediate hire who wants the best training you can get before law school if you want to be a trial lawyer.

We seek recent college graduates to make a commitment of at least a year and a half through at least May 2028. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to this time period.

This is a full time, business hours, in-office position. There is overtime. There can be weekend work; there will be weekend work if you're on trial, have a major filing, or must address a significant client emergency.

We want those who interested in increasing responsibility during their time at the firm, doing work that actually matters, growing and learning as our firm grows, ready to be on teams and take direction, but also able to take initiative and get through the day without being told every task to perform.

You will have a huge amount of freedom and autonomy to do your work, but at the same time will have to be ready to have your schedule during work hours taken over by having to jump in, without notice, on work at the direction of lawyers -- from straightforward tasks such as being on a previously unplanned call, to shifting gears entirely and throwing yourself into a new case.

No education beyond college is needed. Prior writing experience helps, but if you're a good writer we'll make you a great one. Being careful is essential. Being organized and liking rules means this job and this profession may be for you. Flexibility is key. You will learn a ton, but you have to be ready to take the initiative to do all you can to teach yourself under the supervision of highly experienced trial lawyers, besides whom you'll work on complicated cases that matter.

If you want this position be ready to work hard, grow, have fun, do justice, and serve clients.

KEY FEATURES OF THIS ATYPICAL POST-COLLEGE, PRE-LAW SCHOOL POSITION
Analysts work very closely with one another as well as our lawyers on all aspects of our very diverse array of disputes and investigations, and in all parts of running our firm as a business.

This is not a typical paralegal position. It is not for everyone. You will not be coddled. You will have real responsibility. We handle highly complex, very sensitive matters at our small practice, in courts and arbitrations in New York and around the country, for clients from all around the world. We cannot do what we do for our clients without great, committed analysts who own their work and want to do a great job with their colleagues, both on cases, and ensuring our success as a business.

There are regular touch-base meetings and other protocols we follow, but it is hard to describe a typical week or day. We do what is needed working together to win for clients.

You will matter at this firm - to your colleagues and to firm clients - so we require at least two full months' notice (absent exigent circumstances) before you move on which we will help you to do however we can.

To that end, please keep in mind that we do not favor those leaving any employment position less than 12 months after working in such position so if you do apply please be prepared to explain why you are leaving your present position within a year of starting work.

TRAINING
Development of analysts in the law is baked in to the job.

There is some organized training including weekly meetings on the first day of the week when junior staff share what they have learned with senior staff commenting, generally weekly training lunches regarding a topic of present concern, and a few times a year when we have day long training sessions to tighten our practices.

However, most training is done by the constant back and forth of working with senior lawyers on all kinds of trial matters. This includes discussion after key events (such as a hearing or a large filing) of what we did well and how we can improve, but also near daily revision of documents, and frequent discussion at daily case meetings of the work we do.

START DATE IS WITHIN WEEKS
Please note: we do mean "immediate hire" -- we would like someone to begin with us in the next few weeks. Please keep this in mind if you do not live locally.

NOT FOR LAWYERS
Please further note: if you have a law degree of any kind, whether from the United States or overseas you are not a good fit for this position. Please do not apply if you are in law school, have a J.D., or have an LL.M
.

__________________________________________________
ABOUT OUR FIRM AND THE POSITION
Balestriere is a trials and investigations law firm.

Our firm serves businesses, institutions, and individuals involved in disputes around the world. Our team represents our clients at all stages of a dispute including at trial, in arbitration hearings, and in appellate courts, in intense negotiations, in investigations, and when dealing with the government. We drive cases to win.

Some (but not all) Responsibilities of an Analyst

Assist lawyers and any firm staff, including co-counsel of the Firm, in any work of any kind needed to serve clients and run the firm as a business.
Manage case calendars and dockets.
Conduct factual and legal research.
Prepare and file and otherwise address legal documents under supervision of lawyers.
Coordinate and participate in case events.
Communicate with clients and assist in managing client relationships.
Conduct client and witness interviews.
Serve as a liaison between attorneys and the courts.
Serve an essential role in all aspects of evidence development and discovery including exchange of evidence and in depositions, as well as all manner of court and arbitration appearances, including arguments, evidentiary hearings, and trials.
Run and follow up on invoices.
Assist in marketing and client development.
Perform any administrative, business, or executive assistant tasks of any kind which are needed to run the Firm as an efficient, client focused, winning, profitable, justice oriented business.

Required Degree and Skills

Bachelor's degree (further degrees not needed nor preferred; do not apply if you have an advanced degree - but please do not apply if you do not yet have a college degree unless you are graduating within the month).
Superior writing and editing skills (which we will hone and develop).
General proficiency in general office programs, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Adobe Acrobat.
Ability to work quickly and efficiently under strict deadlines.
Flexibility to pivot from one task to another, including addressing unexpected tasks on a routine basis.
Excellent communication skills.
Strong attention to detail, adherence to the rules of courts and practices of our firm, and a commitment to accuracy.
Desire to grow and learn, particularly in working in teams, in writing, and in tactical thinking.
Initiative, resourcefulness, and an ability to work independently as well as closely with others; in particular certain tasks will often be done alone, and after given direction, without constant supervision.
An ability to multitask and prioritize and trust your judgment and to make decisions on your own.
Authorized to work in the United States.

We have a particular interest in hiring those who are first generation college graduates in their family.
Note : no prior paralegal training or experience is required or even expected.
Highly Desired (but not required) : One to three years of prior work experience in any work environment.

Salary and Benefits

The starting salary is $60,000 per year. Employees participate in the firm's health, vision, and dental insurance plans, and the firm pays for most costs associated with insurance. The firm is developing (but does not yet have) a retirement or pension program. Raises are given after six months of successful employment and twelve months of successful employment along with a reaffirmation by the paralegal analyst to her time commitment.

Application Process

Please apply initially through LinkedIn. If we are interested in an interview we shall message you to set up a video meeting and at that time ask you to email your resume (even if you have sent it previously), writing samples, and a list of references. We shall not immediately contact references.

If we proceed through the process we shall then ask you to come into our office space (please note we do not provide reimbursement for any travel) to meet with multiple staff.

After an initial in office meeting, and perhaps a second office meeting with further staff, we will ask to speak with your three references (and we prefer employer, rather than school, references) whom we will contact.

Finally, after that we may ask you to return to the office for a final in person interview.

Support mapping configurations and data preparation required for integration with the Global Risk platform – Matsuri.
Escalate problems proactively and ensure all stakeholders are kept aware of issues and their development.

Create and maintain a knowledge base, support scripts, documentation and procedures.
Collaborate with different IT teams to support multi-platforms’ integration and risk data generation effort.

Qualifications

At least 3+ years of experience supporting a Derivatives line of business (IRD, FXO, EQD) or a Market Risk cross Asset or cross-platform implementation, preferably using Murex 3.1.
Working knowledge in derivatives analytics allowing to engage with Risk Managers.
Working knowledge of Market Risk practices (stress testing, VaR, FRTB, Time Series and valuation).
Familiarity with core calculation modules (Pricing/Position management/risk management).
Usage of SQL, experience in Python, ANT scripting, JSON format.
Ability to multitask several ongoing issues & assess priority.
Effective interpersonal skills and relationship-building skills.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with keen attention to detail.
Self-motivated and directed, with the ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

TheMathCompany or MathCo® is a global Enterprise AI and Analytics company trusted by leading Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises for data-driven decisionmaking. Identifying opportunities to expand client engagements through AI and advanced analytics-led transformation initiatives.
Operating effectively within a global delivery model and coordinating across diverse teams and time zones.

Commercial Insurance or Group Insurance

Renewal Pricing and Retention Strategy
Persistency and Customer Retention Analytics
Actuarial Pricing and Product Management
Portfolio Profitability Management
Price Elasticity Modeling
Underwriting Analytics and Risk Segmentation
Predictive Modeling, AI, and Decision Optimization
Insurance Data and Analytics

Strong understanding of insurance pricing methodologies, renewal strategy, retention management, profitability analysis, portfolio management, and risk segmentation.

The Senior Financial Analyst ensures the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of financial data while providing actionable insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.

This position exercises significant independent judgment in analyzing financial performance, identifying risks and opportunities, recommending process improvements, and implementing solutions that enhance financial controls and operational efficiency. The Senior Financial Analyst also provides direct supervision, guidance, training, and performance oversight for the Financial Analyst and serves as a key liaison between CUEM, University Finance, and departmental stakeholders.

Serves as the lead financial analyst for CUEM, providing oversight and direction for financial operations, reporting, and compliance activities
Monitors, analyzes, and reconciles complex financial transactions, proactively identifying trends, risks, control concerns, and opportunities for improvement

Conducts details financial reviews and audits to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data and adherence to University policies and accounting standards
Develops recommendations and provides strategic guidance to departmental leadership regarding operational initiatives, revenue recovery opportunities, and resource allocation decisions
Supports annual budget development, forecasting, and long-range financial planning activities

Accounts Payable & Receivable:

Leads day-to-day accounts payable and accounts receivable operations, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant transcation processing
Reviews and approves complex payment requests, invoices, credits, receivables, and financial documentation
Monitors aging reports and outstanding balances, identifying issues and driving timely resolution
Serves as the primary resource for resolving escalated billing, payment, and customer account issues
Establishes and maintains effective internal controls and procedures to strengthen financial accuracy and operational efficiency

Internal & External Billing:

Oversees all internal and external billing activities for assigned CUEM business units, ensuring accurate revenue recognition and timely billing
Reviews billing transactions, journal entries, interdepartmental transfers, ITFS, and general ledger activity for accuracy and completeness
Reconciles billing data across multiple systems and investigates discrepancies, implementing corrective actions as needed
Partners closely with CUEM Sales, Operations, and University stakeholders to resolve billing issues and improve revenue cycle processes
Identifies and implements enhancements to billing workflows, controls, and reporting mechanisms

Collaboration & Communication:

Serves as trusted financial advisor and liaison to CUEM leadership, Operations, University Finance, and other University departments
Translates complex financial information into meaningful business insights and recommendations for non-financial stakehoolders
Conducts financial modeling, business case analyses, and ad hoc research to support operational strategic initiatives
Collaborates across departments to improve financial processes, strengthen controls, and ensure alignment with institutional objectives

Other Duties / Special Projects:

Directs, monitors, trains, and evaluates the work of the Financial Analyst, providing ongoing coaching and development
Leads initiatives focused on process improvement, automation, operational efficiency, and data quality enhancement
Supports implementation and optimization of financial systems, reporting tools, and AI-enabled solutions
Manages special projects and executive-level analyses as assigned by Director of CUEM & Dining Finance
Performs related duties and responsibilities as assigned

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Data Analytics, or a related field
Minimum 4-6 years of related experience
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, data transformation, and complex formula construction

Experience building financial models dashboards, and reporting frameworks
Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent platforms preferred
Experience auditing and reconciling financial data across multiple source systems and implementing corrective workflows
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences
Ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and meet hard deadlines without close supervision
Genuine commitment to learning and applying AI-assisted tools for financial reporting, forecasting, and analytical workflows

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial analysis, reporting, or business intelligence in a large, complex institutional environment; higher education or large institutional finance preferred

Prior experience with AI in a finance context also preferred

jobs.title: Manager, Global Consumer Insights & Research
jobs.description:
The NFL's Marketing Strategy, Planning & Insights team serves as a center of excellence for the League, shaping how the NFL grows fans, strengthens the brand, and drives engagement across the U.S. and international markets. The team brings together consumer insights, audience strategy, business planning, initiative-level strategy, and performance measurement to ground decisions in fan understanding, market dynamics, and business priorities. Partnering across business functions and key stakeholders (e.g., the 32 NFL Clubs, partners), the team delivers actionable insights, strategic guidance, and planning frameworks that inform both long-term strategy and day-to-day decisions.

Within this team, Consumer Insights designs and conducts primary research, integrates syndicated and first-party data, and delivers actionable insights across global fan development, brand health, media, live events, marketing effectiveness, partnerships, social responsibility, and player-related priorities.

The Manager, Global Strategic Insights supports research development, analysis, and insights generation to inform global fan development and business growth. The role conducts and synthesizes primary research, syndicated sources, first-party data, and market intelligence to ensure Leaguewide decision-making is grounded in a fan-first perspective.

Responsibilities

Global Fandom Intelligence

Monitor fandom, avidity, engagement, and brand health, as well as the drivers of and barriers to each.
Analyze cultural, behavioral, and regional differences to identify opportunities to acquire, develop, engage, and monetize fans.
Leverage NFL-specific and macro landscape insights to support the development of audience-level strategies by demographic, market, and other relevant segmentation lenses, such as engagement level and football knowledge.

Strategic Insights & Business Planning

Support strategic analyses, forecasts, scenario planning, and performance measurement tied to near- and long-range priorities.
Connect fan behavior, research findings, and marketplace trends to business opportunities and actionable recommendations.
Develop executive-ready presentations, memos, and key planning documents.

Consumer Insights & Research Execution

Support qualitative and quantitative research from objective setting and methodology selection through questionnaire or discussion guide development, analysis, and reporting.
Manage day-to-day stakeholder and vendor coordination, timelines, and deliverables across multiple projects.
Synthesize primary research, syndicated data, first-party information, and secondary sources into concise, story-driven visuals and recommendations using best-in-class practices.

Brand, Media & Marketing Effectiveness

Measure brand campaigns, creative effectiveness, audience sentiment, cultural relevance, and other equity measures across markets and fan segments.
Analyze broadcast, streaming, direct-to-consumer, content, and emerging viewing experiences to inform audience growth, media, product, and marketing strategies.
Evaluate new products, events, experiences, and fan engagement initiatives across the NFL ecosystem.

Stakeholder Partnership & Team Contribution

Build collaborative relationships across the League, Clubs, markets, and external research partners, advocating for fan-centric, insight-driven decisions.
Communicate complex research through clear, concise storytelling tailored to varied audiences.
Coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, timing, and business relevance.
Support junior team members through coaching and project guidance, and improve research processes, reporting standards, and insight socialization.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of relevant experience in consumer insights, market research, strategy, analytics, or a related field.
Ability to translate business questions into research objectives and quantitative or qualitative research plans.
Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex findings and communicate concise, actionable insights to varied stakeholders.
Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with experience creating executive-ready presentations and insight-driven reports.
Strong project management, cross-functional collaboration, and relationship-building skills in a fast-paced environment.
Experience with research methods such as segmentation, surveys, ethnography, interviews, and focus groups, plus familiarity with syndicated media measurement and applied analytics.
Proficiency with analytical tools such as Microsoft Excel, SPSS, or Q.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

Experience managing vendors and/or analysts; strong people management capabilities preferred.
Familiarity with sports and entertainment; knowledge of media and live events is a plus.
Experience working with global or multinational businesses and measurement frameworks strongly preferred.
Spanish, Portuguese, French, and/or German language proficiency is a plus.
Master’s degree in Market Research preferred.

Terms / Expected Hours of Work

Some travel required
NFL employees are required to work in office

Salary / Pay Range

This job posting contains a pay range, which represents the range of salaries or hourly rates that the NFL believes, in good faith, at the time of this posting that it might be willing to pay for the posted job in the location(s) specified. The NFL expects to hire for this position near the middle of the range. Only in truly rare and exceptional circumstances, where an external candidate has experience, credentials or expertise that far exceed those required or expected for the position, would the NFL consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.

Salary

$115,000—$125,000 USD

Benefits Information

To learn more about our comprehensive benefits offerings, please visit: NFL BENEFITS

At the NFL, in-person work at our offices is a top priority because it allows us to collaborate more effectively, build stronger connections, and maintain the culture that drives our success. This role requires onsite presence at an NFL office or stadium location, and remote and/or hybrid working options are not offered.

NO RELOCATION ASSISTANCE WILL BE PROVIDED.

The NFL is committed to building an inclusive work environment that reflects our incredible fan base. We provide an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all employees and applicants without regard to status as protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Respect: Everyone matters. We celebrate diverse opinions, honor hard work, and value every contribution.

Team Responsibility: We support each other and our communities. No one is bigger than the game, and every action impacts others.

Build Talent: We develop and nurture potential, empowering individuals to grow and succeed.
Execute: We take action with precision, delivering results that drive our goals forward.

Live Our Values: We embody our core principles in every decision and action.
Know the Business: We stay informed, understand our industry, and make decisions that strengthen our position.
Think Big: We challenge the status quo, envision bold possibilities, and strive for transformative impact

Who You Are

Embody an enthusiastic, proactive can-do attitude
Embrace grit, free from ego or entitlement
Excel as a relationship builder, with the ability to influence
Eager learner, driven by passion rather than just ambition
Encompasses an incredible work ethic with an agile mindset

jobs.title: Business Automation Analyst
jobs.description:
Our client, a major bank, is looking to hire a Business Automation Analyst
in New York, NY or Jersey City, NJ.

Pay Rate Range:
$60-65/hr W2, based on experience

Responsibilities:

LOCATION: can sit in either Jersey City or NYC (1 NY Plaza)

- Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days remote

Automation Initiatives – Wealth Management Operations
Job Summary: We are seeking an Associate to support and drive automation initiatives within our Wealth Management Operations division. In this role, you will balance technical development skills with business analysis and stakeholder engagement. You will work closely with operations teams to identify high-impact process automation opportunities and implement solutions using RPA platforms (such as UiPath, Power Automate, etc..) and scripting languages (Python, VBA, SQL, etc.). The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of operational processes and controls, experience delivering automation projects, and excellent communication skills to ensure successful adoption of new solutions.

Responsibilities & capabilities
• Process Analysis & Opportunity Identification: Work with TEMCO teams to uncover automation use cases, evaluate feasibility and potential value, and prioritize quick-win opportunities. Clearly document business requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes for each initiative.
• Automation Solution Design & Development: Translate business and control requirements into robust automation solution designs. Design, build, test, and deploy automation solutions using RPA tools, workflow automation software, and scripting technologies. Ensure solutions are scalable, resilient, and meet performance expectations. Support user acceptance testing (UAT), rollout, and operational readiness for all automation deployments.
• Stakeholder Engagement & Change Adoption: Serve as a liaison between technology teams and business stakeholders in operations. Provide training and guidance to operations staff adopting new automated processes to ensure smooth transitions. After implementation, highlight achieved improvements and value to encourage organization-wide support for automation initiatives.
• Production Support & Continuous Improvement: Monitor and support production automations, promptly investigating and resolving any incidents or exceptions to minimize business disruption. Perform root-cause analysis on automation failures and implement enhancements to prevent recurrence. Gather feedback post-implementation and drive continuous improvement of automation solutions and processes. Identify opportunities to reuse components and implement best practices to increase efficiency and consistency across Wealth Management Operations automation projects.
• Communication & Reporting: Provide transparent updates on project status, risks, and realized benefits to stakeholders and leadership. Ensure any risks or issues are escalated in a timely manner and that project milestones are well-communicated.

Requirements:

*** HM: "Consulting experience is a plus however the role is primarily an automation and data analytics position. We are looking for someone with advanced technical background in building automation solutions. "

TOP SKILLS

1. Minimum 5 years' experience

2. BACHELOR'S REQUIRED in Business or Computer Science or related field

3. Data fluency

4. Certification in automation tools preferred

Qualifications

• Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Approximately 5+ years of experience designing and delivering process automation solutions in the financial services industry (preferably within Wealth Management Operations).
• Automation Tools Expertise: Hands-on experience with leading RPA/automation platforms – such as Alteryx, UiPath & Microsoft Power Automate for developing automated workflows. Strong scripting/programming skills in languages like Python, VBA, or SQL for building custom automation scripts and integrations.
• Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of Wealth Management Operations processes, including areas like trade processing, settlements, reconciliations, client reporting, reference data, and exception management.
• Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Demonstrated strength in business analysis, process mapping, and problem-solving. Ability to analyze complex operational workflows, identify inefficiencies, and define improvement solutions. Critical thinking skills to challenge assumptions, validate automation outcomes, and ensure solutions are robust and error proofed by design.

Education Level
Bachelor's Degree
Experience Level

Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders.

Experience with cloud data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

new_jobs.title: Treasury Analyst - Orion Platform
new_jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Treasury Analyst
New York, NY
Our Culture at Orion
At Orion, we are builders. We want to be the gold standard for people in the Commercial Services trades. We are building a 100+ year business with an A+ team, driven, excited about the future, and looking for people who want to build with us. We believe in hiring people with a growth mindset who are committed to building something bigger than themselves. Our culture is grounded in four core values: Coach, Compete, Collaborate, and Commit. We strive to be low ego, high performance, and deeply committed to our people, our Operating Companies, and our long-term vision.
Orion Services Group is a growing network of commercial services businesses across the United States, spanning HVAC, electrical, plumbing, building automation, and related trades. We are highly acquisitive, integrating 10-15 operating companies per year, and converting each acquisition into a stable, growth-ready business within the first 90 days of ownership.
Orion is a roll-up-your-sleeves culture. At all levels, we expect people to prioritize, act quickly and effectively, demonstrate agility in their thinking, and get the job done every day. This is not a sit-back-and-direct environment. We value doers, problem-solvers, and people who are hands-on and decisive.
The Role
The Treasury Analyst keeps cash moving across Orion's network of operating companies, from the weekly forecasting cycle through banking, payments, and lender reporting. This role sits on the Platform Treasury team and reports to the VP, Finance, Platform Treasury.
You will serve two groups of clients. Our operating companies rely on you to run a predictable forecasting cycle, get newly acquired companies up to speed, and help them improve how they manage working capital. Platform leadership relies on you for a clear group-level view of cash, a secure and well-administered banking platform, and accurate support for acquisition funding and lender reporting.
This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one. It blends recurring weekly and monthly cycles with project work, and a big part of the job is continuous improvement: finding ways to make each process faster, cleaner, and more automated over time. You will partner every week with OpCo finance leaders, Controllership, FP&A, Capital Markets, the deal team, and our banking partners.
What We Are Looking For
Core Competencies
Attention to detail - you check your own work before anyone else sees it, and you treat every wire, entitlement change, and forecast number as something that has to be right.
Follow-through - you keep the forecasting calendar on track and follow up with OpCo finance leaders until submissions are complete, without needing to be chased yourself.
Analytical curiosity - when a forecast misses or working capital moves, you dig in to understand why and help the OpCo fix the root cause, not just explain the variance.
Continuous improvement mindset - you look for ways to make each cycle faster, cleaner, and more automated, and you document the process so it runs the same way every time.
Sound judgment - you handle bank access, payments, and confidential financial information with care, and you know when to escalate.
Clear communication - you write and speak directly, and you can explain cash results to OpCo controllers and platform leaders alike.
Comfort with a fast pace - you balance recurring deadlines with project work and new acquisitions, and stay organized as priorities shift.
Low ego, high collaboration - you build strong working relationships across Treasury, Controllership, FP&A, the deal team, and the operating companies.
Experience and Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in treasury, corporate finance, FP&A, or public accounting, including relevant internships.
Solid Excel and data skills and a desire to grow them, including learning to build models others can follow, plus comfort using AI tools to automate and speed up routine work.
Exposure to J.P. Morgan Access or another commercial banking platform is a plus.

new_jobs.title: Paralegal Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Balestriere Law Firm is seeking a paralegal-legal analyst for immediate hire who wants the best training you can get before law school if you want to be a trial lawyer.

We seek recent college graduates to make a commitment of at least a year and a half through at least May 2028. Please do not apply if you cannot commit to this time period.

This is a full time, business hours, in-office position. There is overtime. There can be weekend work; there will be weekend work if you're on trial, have a major filing, or must address a significant client emergency.

We want those who interested in increasing responsibility during their time at the firm, doing work that actually matters, growing and learning as our firm grows, ready to be on teams and take direction, but also able to take initiative and get through the day without being told every task to perform.

You will have a huge amount of freedom and autonomy to do your work, but at the same time will have to be ready to have your schedule during work hours taken over by having to jump in, without notice, on work at the direction of lawyers -- from straightforward tasks such as being on a previously unplanned call, to shifting gears entirely and throwing yourself into a new case.

No education beyond college is needed. Prior writing experience helps, but if you're a good writer we'll make you a great one. Being careful is essential. Being organized and liking rules means this job and this profession may be for you. Flexibility is key. You will learn a ton, but you have to be ready to take the initiative to do all you can to teach yourself under the supervision of highly experienced trial lawyers, besides whom you'll work on complicated cases that matter.

If you want this position be ready to work hard, grow, have fun, do justice, and serve clients.

KEY FEATURES OF THIS ATYPICAL POST-COLLEGE, PRE-LAW SCHOOL POSITION
Analysts work very closely with one another as well as our lawyers on all aspects of our very diverse array of disputes and investigations, and in all parts of running our firm as a business.

This is not a typical paralegal position. It is not for everyone. You will not be coddled. You will have real responsibility. We handle highly complex, very sensitive matters at our small practice, in courts and arbitrations in New York and around the country, for clients from all around the world. We cannot do what we do for our clients without great, committed analysts who own their work and want to do a great job with their colleagues, both on cases, and ensuring our success as a business.

There are regular touch-base meetings and other protocols we follow, but it is hard to describe a typical week or day. We do what is needed working together to win for clients.

You will matter at this firm - to your colleagues and to firm clients - so we require at least two full months' notice (absent exigent circumstances) before you move on which we will help you to do however we can.

To that end, please keep in mind that we do not favor those leaving any employment position less than 12 months after working in such position so if you do apply please be prepared to explain why you are leaving your present position within a year of starting work.

TRAINING
Development of analysts in the law is baked in to the job.

There is some organized training including weekly meetings on the first day of the week when junior staff share what they have learned with senior staff commenting, generally weekly training lunches regarding a topic of present concern, and a few times a year when we have day long training sessions to tighten our practices.

However, most training is done by the constant back and forth of working with senior lawyers on all kinds of trial matters. This includes discussion after key events (such as a hearing or a large filing) of what we did well and how we can improve, but also near daily revision of documents, and frequent discussion at daily case meetings of the work we do.

START DATE IS WITHIN WEEKS
Please note: we do mean "immediate hire" -- we would like someone to begin with us in the next few weeks. Please keep this in mind if you do not live locally.

NOT FOR LAWYERS
Please further note: if you have a law degree of any kind, whether from the United States or overseas you are not a good fit for this position. Please do not apply if you are in law school, have a J.D., or have an LL.M
.

__________________________________________________
ABOUT OUR FIRM AND THE POSITION
Balestriere is a trials and investigations law firm.

Our firm serves businesses, institutions, and individuals involved in disputes around the world. Our team represents our clients at all stages of a dispute including at trial, in arbitration hearings, and in appellate courts, in intense negotiations, in investigations, and when dealing with the government. We drive cases to win.

Some (but not all) Responsibilities of an Analyst

Assist lawyers and any firm staff, including co-counsel of the Firm, in any work of any kind needed to serve clients and run the firm as a business.
Manage case calendars and dockets.
Conduct factual and legal research.
Prepare and file and otherwise address legal documents under supervision of lawyers.
Coordinate and participate in case events.
Communicate with clients and assist in managing client relationships.
Conduct client and witness interviews.
Serve as a liaison between attorneys and the courts.
Serve an essential role in all aspects of evidence development and discovery including exchange of evidence and in depositions, as well as all manner of court and arbitration appearances, including arguments, evidentiary hearings, and trials.
Run and follow up on invoices.
Assist in marketing and client development.
Perform any administrative, business, or executive assistant tasks of any kind which are needed to run the Firm as an efficient, client focused, winning, profitable, justice oriented business.

Required Degree and Skills

Bachelor's degree (further degrees not needed nor preferred; do not apply if you have an advanced degree - but please do not apply if you do not yet have a college degree unless you are graduating within the month).
Superior writing and editing skills (which we will hone and develop).
General proficiency in general office programs, including Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and Adobe Acrobat.
Ability to work quickly and efficiently under strict deadlines.
Flexibility to pivot from one task to another, including addressing unexpected tasks on a routine basis.
Excellent communication skills.
Strong attention to detail, adherence to the rules of courts and practices of our firm, and a commitment to accuracy.
Desire to grow and learn, particularly in working in teams, in writing, and in tactical thinking.
Initiative, resourcefulness, and an ability to work independently as well as closely with others; in particular certain tasks will often be done alone, and after given direction, without constant supervision.
An ability to multitask and prioritize and trust your judgment and to make decisions on your own.
Authorized to work in the United States.

We have a particular interest in hiring those who are first generation college graduates in their family.
Note : no prior paralegal training or experience is required or even expected.
Highly Desired (but not required) : One to three years of prior work experience in any work environment.

Salary and Benefits

The starting salary is $60,000 per year. Employees participate in the firm's health, vision, and dental insurance plans, and the firm pays for most costs associated with insurance. The firm is developing (but does not yet have) a retirement or pension program. Raises are given after six months of successful employment and twelve months of successful employment along with a reaffirmation by the paralegal analyst to her time commitment.

Application Process

Please apply initially through LinkedIn. If we are interested in an interview we shall message you to set up a video meeting and at that time ask you to email your resume (even if you have sent it previously), writing samples, and a list of references. We shall not immediately contact references.

If we proceed through the process we shall then ask you to come into our office space (please note we do not provide reimbursement for any travel) to meet with multiple staff.

After an initial in office meeting, and perhaps a second office meeting with further staff, we will ask to speak with your three references (and we prefer employer, rather than school, references) whom we will contact.

Finally, after that we may ask you to return to the office for a final in person interview.

TheMathCompany or MathCo® is a global Enterprise AI and Analytics company trusted by leading Fortune 500 and Global 2000 enterprises for data-driven decisionmaking. We are seeking an experienced Associate Principal – Insurance Strategy & Analytics with deep Insurance domain expertise to lead strategic AI and advanced analytics engagements for leading insurance carriers. As part of the Customer Success team, you will work closely with business leaders across Pricing, Actuarial, Underwriting, Analytics, and Technology functions to solve complex insurance business challenges and deliver measurable business outcomes.

Communicating analytical insights, recommendations, delivery progress, risks, and business impact to senior client stakeholders.
Driving executive-level stakeholder communication, governance, risk management, issue resolution, and alignment across client and internal teams.
Driving solution adoption through stakeholder engagement, demonstrations, user validation, UAT, pilots, and change management.
Identifying opportunities to expand client engagements through AI and advanced analytics-led transformation initiatives.
Operating effectively within a global delivery model and coordinating across diverse teams and time zones.

Ideal Candidate Background

The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in one or more of the following areas:
Commercial Insurance or Group Insurance
Insurance Pricing Strategy and Rate Optimization
Renewal Pricing and Retention Strategy
Persistency and Customer Retention Analytics
Actuarial Pricing and Product Management
Portfolio Profitability Management
Price Elasticity Modeling
Underwriting Analytics and Risk Segmentation
Predictive Modeling, AI, and Decision Optimization
Insurance Data and Analytics

8-12 years of experience in consulting, analytics, AI, digital transformation, or related client-facing leadership roles.
5+ years of experience leading analytics, pricing, actuarial, or transformation programs within insurance organizations.
Demonstrated experience working directly with Pricing, Actuarial, Underwriting, Analytics, and Technology stakeholders.
Strong understanding of insurance pricing methodologies, renewal strategy, retention management, profitability analysis, portfolio management, and risk segmentation.
Hands-on experience supporting or leading initiatives involving rate optimization, renewal pricing, retention strategy, pricing analytics, or actuarial decision-making.
Experience evaluating analytical approaches such as price elasticity modeling, retention modeling, persistency analysis, predictive modeling, optimization, or decision science.
Ability to engage credibly with pricing actuaries, actuarial leadership, underwriting executives, product teams, and analytics leaders.
Experience leading enterprise AI, advanced analytics, or data-driven transformation programs from business problem definition through implementation and adoption.
Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and client relationship management skills.
Experience leading global, cross-functional teams spanning Data Science, Engineering, Product, Analytics, and Business functions.
Demonstrated ability to manage complex consulting engagements, including scope, timelines, resources, risks, and commercial commitments.

Success in this role means serving as a trusted advisor to Pricing, Actuarial, and Underwriting leaders while helping clients use AI and advanced analytics to improve rate effectiveness, renewal performance, customer retention, profitability, and overall business growth. The Senior Financial Analyst ensures the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of financial data while providing actionable insights that support operational and strategic decision-making.

Establishes and maintains effective internal controls and procedures to strengthen financial accuracy and operational efficiency

Identifies and implements enhancements to billing workflows, controls, and reporting mechanisms

Conducts financial modeling, business case analyses, and ad hoc research to support operational strategic initiatives
Collaborates across departments to improve financial processes, strengthen controls, and ensure alignment with institutional objectives

Directs, monitors, trains, and evaluates the work of the Financial Analyst, providing ongoing coaching and development
